name: nx
description: Fig completions for Nx by Nrwl

subcommands.name: init
subcommands.description: Adds nx.json file and installs nx if not installed already

subcommands.name: generate
subcommands.description: Runs a generator that creates and/or modifies files based on a generator from a collection

subcommands.name: run
subcommands.description: Runs an Architect target with an optional custom builder configuration defined in your project

subcommands.name: daemon
subcommands.description: Prints information about the Nx Daemon process or starts a daemon process

subcommands.name: graph
subcommands.description: Graph dependencies within workspace

subcommands.name: run-many
subcommands.description: Run target for multiple listed projects

subcommands.name: affected
subcommands.description: Run target for affected projects

subcommands.name: affected:graph
subcommands.description: Graph dependencies affected by changes

subcommands.name: print-affected
subcommands.description: Prints information about the projects and targets affected by changes

subcommands.name: format:check
subcommands.description: Check for un-formatted files

subcommands.name: format:write
subcommands.description: Overwrite un-formatted files

subcommands.name: migrate
subcommands.description: Creates a migrations file or runs migrations from the migrations file

subcommands.name: report
subcommands.description: Reports useful version numbers to copy into the Nx issue template

args.name: plugin
args.description: The name of an installed plugin to query

subcommands.name: workspace-generator
subcommands.description: Runs a workspace generator from the tools/generators directory

subcommands.name: connect
subcommands.description: Connect workspace to Nx Cloud

subcommands.name: reset
subcommands.description: Clears all the cached Nx artifacts and metadata about the workspace and shuts down the Nx Daemon

subcommands.name: repair
subcommands.description: Repair any configuration that is no longer supported by Nx

subcommands.name: exec
subcommands.description: Executes any command as if it was a target on the project

subcommands.name: watch
subcommands.description: Watch for changes within projects, and execute commands

subcommands.name: show
subcommands.description: Show information about the workspace (e.g., list of projects)

subcommands.name: view-logs
subcommands.description: Enables you to view and interact with the logs via the advanced analytic UI from Nx Cloud to help you debug your issue. To do this, Nx needs to connect your workspace to Nx Cloud and upload the most recent run details. Only the metrics are uploaded, not the artefacts
